_tuning_notes: Mountain gorilla: windswept hills + grove, thicker fur texture, +4 health over lowland, slightly smaller troops. Proves biome-tag species routing from the same entity class. Phase 3: forage block = melon/berry raids (mobGriefing-gated); a fed troop is 'content' for content_minutes: taming chance doubles (2/3), chest-beat cooldown doubles, roaming calms. cage_tier 2 = reinforced cage required. Phase 3.1: fur is a per-individual pick from the 'textures' list (stable per entity); the silverback saddle is a translucent overlay layer, so it composes with every fur colour instead of needing a silverback copy of each. RARITY: tier 'rare' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (3-5, cap 8). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever. VARIANT ROLLS: albino at 5% per gorilla, rolled ONCE at spawn and persisted in NBT so an individual never re-rolls; babies roll independently, so an albino born into a normal troop is the jackpot sighting. Otherwise identical — same stats, troop role and taming. Generic: any species can gain a rare coat by adding a variant_rolls entry, no Java.
guide_blurb: Thicker coat, thinner air, same rules.
